title: Family verdict: orbit-measured physical signals vs liquid market returns
one_liner: 0 of 46 market-tier tests survive BH at q=0.05 (smallest q=0.16); the p-value distribution is indistinguishable from the placebo battery.

datasets.name: Global Water Watch reservoir surface area (Landsat/Sentinel-2 derived)
VIIRS S-NPP 375 m thermal anomalies, NASA GIBS vector tiles, daily 2012-01-20..2026-09-18 (5,355 days x 3 tiles)
GloFAS v4 river discharge via Open-Meteo Flood API (Kaub; Budapest, Saumur placebos)
NVE weekly reservoir filling, Norway 1995-2026
Brazil ONS open data: EAR by subsystem (daily), CMO (weekly), energy balance (hourly)
Yahoo Finance daily closes via yfinance
SHFE aluminium main contract AL0 (Sina Finance via akshare)
EIA-930 hourly generation by source (PUDL nightly parquet, cached by scout)

mechanism: A physical supply shock visible from orbit (low reservoir, dark flares, low river) should move the price of the constrained commodity or the equity of the exposed producer in the weeks/months after the satellite value becomes knowable.
method: Pre-registered (prereg.json, sha256 in data/prereg.sha256) before any signal-target statistic was computed. Signals: expanding-window deseasonalised anomalies (no full-sample statistics), lagged by product latency. Targets: log returns (equities in excess of local index). Statistic: max |Pearson r| over pre-registered lags; null = 10,000 block-permutation+circular-shift surrogates (calibrated on synthetic AR data: 5% false-positive rate); exact circular-shift and year-shuffle nulls as cross-checks; Benjamini-Hochberg across the whole family; 60/40 chronological OOS split; partial-out of commodity index/DXY/Shanghai Composite; placebo reservoirs.

Year-shuffle and exact circular-shift nulls agree with the block null. Signs match the pre-registered mechanism in 46% of market tests and train/test signs agree in 39% - coin flips.
known_or_novel: known in spirit (semi-strong efficiency; Mukherjee et al. 2021 show satellite estimates are already impounded in prices) - the contribution is a clean, pre-registered, keyless replication across 6 physical systems
caveats: Monthly/weekly horizons only; latency assumptions are conservative (1 month for GWW); power is limited for |r|<0.15; equities tested in excess of the local index only; no options/vol or intraday targets; results describe statistical association, not trading advice.
